name: OS Sandboxing & Isolation Evaluation
description: Evaluation and bypass testing of OS-level sandboxing and application isolation mechanisms. Covers Windows Sandbox and AppContainer, macOS App Sandbox and Hardened Runtime, Linux Landlock, seccomp-bpf profiles, Flatpak and Snap confinement, Chromium-style multi-process sandboxes, and isolation boundary analysis for security product evaluation.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to OS sandboxing evaluation

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands sandboxing concepts and isolation mechanisms across major OSes
evidence: Can explain Windows AppContainer, macOS App Sandbox, and Linux seccomp/Landlock
Understands the principle of least privilege as applied to sandbox design
Familiar with common sandbox escape categories (file system, IPC, kernel)
Completed introductory training on OS isolation mechanisms

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Enumerates sandbox configurations and tests known escape techniques under supervision
evidence: Enumerated sandbox policies and restrictions on target applications
Tested known sandbox escape techniques against lab environments
Analyzed Flatpak/Snap confinement profiles for overly permissive configurations
Work reviewed by authorized researcher

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently evaluates sandbox implementations and identifies weaknesses
evidence: Independently assessed sandbox boundary integrity for 3+ applications
Identifies IPC and file system based sandbox escape vectors
Evaluates sandbox policy completeness against application threat model
Passed proficiency assessment on sandbox evaluation

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Discovers novel sandbox escapes; evaluates complex multi-layered isolation
evidence: Discovers sandbox escape vulnerabilities through auditing and fuzzing
Evaluates multi-layered isolation architectures (sandbox + container + hypervisor)
Assesses browser and productivity application sandbox implementations
Mentors team on sandbox evaluation methodology

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Authority on OS isolation; published sandbox escape research
evidence: Published research or CVEs on sandbox escape vulnerabilities
Developed lab methodology for sandbox and isolation evaluation
Contributes to sandbox design guidance for application developers
Trains teams and presents at conferences on sandbox security

assessment_methods.description: Evaluate the sandbox implementation of a provided application, document the isolation boundary, and identify potential escape vectors
Given a sandbox policy configuration, identify weaknesses and propose escape strategies with justification
